source_path_base: original engineering evidence bundle root; paths below are relative identifiers
scope: Read-only extraction from existing committed archives; no simulation, replay execution, model request, source edit, or inferred missing state

definitions.event_step: tick - 5; u=0 is the shared committed pre-event state
definitions.infected_percent: 100 times count of snapshot.data.kdd27.states values whose infection is I, divided by 20; current I state, not cumulative exposure
definitions.confidence_mean: Unweighted arithmetic mean of all 20 snapshot.data.kdd27.states[actor].confidence values
definitions.emotion_mean: Unweighted arithmetic mean of all 20 snapshot.data.kdd27.states[actor].emotion values; archived bounded internal emotion state, not external sentiment data
definitions.volume_shares: For u>=1, sum quantity_units over market ledger journal trades with trade.tick equal to current tick; u=0 intentionally blank because it is the pre-event observation

reconstruction.method: Read commits 00000005 through 00000032 in order. Load the initial snapshot from the referenced compressed segment. Apply each later set/delete/append delta in memory with append-offset checks. Verify compressed segment size/SHA-256 and research-canonical-v1 typed state hash at every step. Compare the final snapshot exactly with the archived tick32 checkpoint.
